input.title: [Android] Copied text from Context Menu  is not saved onto the Clipboard
input.body: ## Step to Reproduce 1. Create a new thought 2. Add with text 3. Select a word or phrase 4. Tap Copy on the Context menu 5. Open clipboard ## Current behavior Copied text is not shown on the clipboard, disregard the alert shows "Copied to Clipboard" https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/53e25788-d9ac-42ca-bcc1-c996fad0e3c1 ## Expected behavior Copied text should appear on the Clipboard
